description: Election Commission - T. S Priyadharshana was Selected as the Member of the Nuwaragampalatha Central Pradeshiya Sabha, J. H. M. A. Kumara Jayasundara was Selected as the Member of the Palagala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to members ceasing to belong to their political parties. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of new members to fill these vacancies. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing candidate nominations and declarations for local government positions.
